objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that passes through creation, editing, release, distribution, validity extension, override, and archiving lifecycle stages.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation code assigned to the document (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document, incremented upon revision or attachment changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 10 years) after which archived documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The MS Office format in which the document content is authored (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents, master data, or IT applications maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity specified for the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification category for documents that determines templates, abbreviation codes, validity periods, and archive durations (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (e.g. Level 2 for Guidelines, Level 4 for Work Instructions).

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Language-independent abbreviation for the document type.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension checks configured per document type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Default archive retention period configured per document type.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, following the main document release cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary sub-document linked to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published or deleted directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional information has been published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request proposing changes to an existing released document, managed independently from the document version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and potentially extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering an archiving workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its validity and authorizations.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents and supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user assigned as the primary responsible person for creating and maintaining a document, automatically set upon document creation.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user assigned additional write permissions on a document who can also initiate the release workflow but does not sign in the Creator step.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user responsible for checking document content for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for approving and releasing a document, deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released document content into another language; cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can only view approved and released documents, accessing them via the reader dashboard.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used for assigning read/change authorizations, distribution, and role-based access to documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configured list of user groups and individual persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email (notification only) or for acknowledgement (requires active confirmation).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that orchestrates the steps of document release, validity extension, override, or reactivation.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: The type of workflow process (e.g. Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the electronic signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which the signature was provided (Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a reader or distribution list member that they have read and noted a released document version.

attributes.name: confirmed
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed by the recipient.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity to which documents can be linked via master data references.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process to which documents can be linked, enabling process-specific filing.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application referenced as master data in document properties.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read, write).

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first step of the release workflow using an electronic signature.

evts.name: perform_review
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the review task.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Whether the review was approved or rejected.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Whether the review was technical or formal.

evts.name: perform_release
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available for distribution to readers.

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Whether the release was approved or rejected.

evts.name: reject_in_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing immediate cancellation for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The workflow step at which the rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all data from the previous version.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for version creation (content change, attachment change, change proposal implementation, reactivation).

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment (controlled sub-document) is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of a change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension is processed through a workflow, checking whether the document is still valid in its current version.

attributes.name: extension_decision
attributes.description: Decision outcome: extend validity, revise document, or invalidate.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default validity period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow with review and release steps.

attributes.name: override_process_type
attributes.description: Whether override is by releaser only or by initiator, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force: the last valid version receives Out of Force status, all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are archived by revoking all authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is processed by the initiator, restoring the document to active status with a new version.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, email notifications are sent to users and user groups on the distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, acknowledgement workflow tasks are sent to users and user groups on the distribution list requiring active confirmation.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader or distribution list member actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is being translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is reviewed and released through a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to a specific document type that determines its classification, templates, and lifecycle parameters.
An attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to a specific main document and follows its release cycle.
Additional information is a supplementary object linked to a specific main document without affecting its version.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and proposes modifications to its content.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to initiate its invalidation.
A reactivation request references the specific archived document to be reactivated.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A distribution list is maintained per document, specifying who receives notifications or acknowledgement requests.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list for distribution purposes.
Documents can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units via master data references.
Documents can reference IT applications as master data in their properties.
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute.
Authors must be assigned to the Authors user group to be available in the author selection list.
Reviewers must be assigned to the Reviewer user group to be available in the reviewer selection list.
Releasers must be assigned to the Releaser user group to be available in the releaser selection list.
Readers are assigned to reader user groups that grant them view access to documents.
